      li.innerHTML = `<span>${escapeText(r.label)}</span><span style="position:relative;height:10px;background:var(--rule,#eceeef);border-radius:2px"><span style="position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:${(r.value / max) * 100}%;background:var(--chart-1,#2f6fdf);border-radius:2px"></span><span style="position:absolute;top:-4px;bottom:-4px;left:${(r.target / max) * 100}%;width:2px;margin-left:-1px;background:var(--text,#111)"></span></span><span><b style="font-weight:500">${escapeText(format(r.value))}</b> <span style="color:${Math.abs(drift) >= (r.tolerance ?? 0.02) ? 'var(--negative,#c4242a)' : 'var(--muted,#5f6368)'}">${drift >= 0 ? '+' : '−'}${escapeText(format(Math.abs(drift)))} vs ${escapeText(format(r.target))}</span></span>`;
